metric_scope.joint_nll: Event-weighted full joint mark NLL, conditional on a logged exposure (KuaiRand) or retained positive merchandise invoice (Retail). Different H/domain values must not be pooled.
metric_scope.seed_sd: Optimization variation on the same fixed data window; not independent datasets.
metric_scope.intervals: Seed-averaged paired calendar-block bootstrap of fixed fitted models; 5000 resamples; 3-day blocks for KuaiRand, 7-day for Retail; exploratory unadjusted 95% intervals.
metric_scope.training: Each epoch/variant selected using validation only. Reported joint NLL is event weighted; training uses daily mean with count, two-step, and regularization terms.
metric_scope.parameters: Allocated tensor counts may include gauge/unused coordinates; Gaussian-discrete representation matches effective parameters as in v3.
metric_scope.horizons: Predict endpoint h days from each rolling origin; freeze lag features and assimilate only dates earlier than origin. Longer horizons have fewer valid origins.

standard.information_scope: Same bucket, dates and events; event model conditions on individual history, aggregate model on lagged cohort counts. This compares information granularity, not loss compression under identical context.

random.information_scope: Same bucket, dates and events; event model conditions on individual history, aggregate model on lagged cohort counts. This compares information granularity, not loss compression under identical context.

metric_scope.joint_nll: invoice-weighted joint basket-pattern NLL conditional on observed positive transaction
metric_scope.count: retained positive merchandise invoices per calendar day
metric_scope.seed_sd: training-seed standard deviation within one fixed test window
metric_scope.interval: paired circular moving-calendar-block percentile interval, 7-day blocks, 5000 resamples; fixed fitted models; unadjusted exploratory intervals; only 17 test days per window

data.unknown_group_anchor: one fixed reference unit; not a person/visit/opportunity count
one fixed reference unit; not a person/visit/opportunity count

ingarch_scope: NLL per daily total; one-step exact conditional NB, multi-step plug-in NB diagnostic, unlike the mean-cell NB NLL of market models.
projected_gru_scope: Separate post-architecture-audit baseline with a trainable full hidden-to-behavior projection. Some original test results had been inspected. Not part of the original validation-selected family or a parameter-matched Gaussian ablation.
